data.title: Proadprans to take over as SAT chief from Oct 1
data.description: The cabinet approved the Ministry of Tourism and Sports' proposal to appoint Proadprans Samarnmit as the governor of the Sports Authority of Thailand, government deputy spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said on Tuesday.

data.title: Thais refuse to let absences hinder bid
data.description: Thailand's U23 squad continued their preparations on Tuesday for the men's football tournament of the 2026 Asian Games in Japan, with midfielder Thanakrit Chotmuangpak stressing that the absence of two key figures will not derail the team's ambitions.

data.title: Real Madrid win Champions League opener as Haaland stars for Man City
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Jose Mourinho got off to a winning start on his return to the Champions League with Real Madrid on Tuesday as the Spanish giants beat Inter Milan 2-1, while Erling Haaland scored twice in Manchester City's victory at Porto.

data.title: World Cup final scorer Torres leads Ballon d'Or nominees
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Ferran Torres, whose goal against Argentina won the World Cup for Spain in July, leads a 30-man list for the men's Ballon d'Or revealed on Tuesday.

data.title: Super Bowl rematch kicks off NFL season as league expands global reach
data.description: LOS ANGELES - The most ambitious NFL season in history kicks off on Wednesday with a Super Bowl rematch, an unprecedented global schedule and a clutch of contenders plotting to dethrone the Seattle Seahawks.

data.title: Bissoli heroics give Buriram winning start
data.description: Buriram United made a winning start under interim head coach Emerson Pereira, beating Sukhothai 3-1 in the Thai League 1 opener at Thung Talay Luang Stadium on Sunday night.

data.title: Comeback queen Zheng strikes again for US Open quarter-final berth
data.description: NEW YORK - Olympic gold medallist Zheng QinWen pulled off another incredible comeback Monday to stun six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Swiatek and reach the US Open quarter-finals.

data.title: 'Super-human' Alcaraz books US Open quarter-final clash with Shelton
data.description: NEW YORK — Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz posted his most convincing win in his injury return at the US Open, downing Tommy Paul in straight sets on Sunday to line up a quarter-final clash with Ben Shelton.

data.title: Ohtani 'unlikely' to pitch again this season, says Dodgers manager
data.description: LOS ANGELES, United States — Los Angeles Dodgers two-way superstar Shohei Ohtani is unlikely to pitch again this season, team manager Dave Roberts said Sunday.

data.title: PSG go for three in a row as Champions League returns
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Another UEFA Champions League season gets going this week with the beginning of the league phase as Paris Saint-Germain bid to join the tiny band of clubs to have won the competition three years running.

data.title: Sensational Antonelli wins Italian GP from back of grid
data.description: MONZA (ITALY) - Championship leader Kimi Antonelli delivered one of the most sensational triumphs in the long history of the Italian Grand Prix on Sunday when he became the first home winner in 60 years after starting from 19th on the grid.

data.title: Buriram, Jackson part ways
data.description: <p>Thai League 1 coaches are usually given time to fail before the axe falls -- sackings and resignations tend to pile up as a season wears on. This time, the upheaval has arrived before a ball has even been kicked.</p>

data.title: Hail the Hiro: Thai teenager bags historic ISU medal
data.description: <p>Hiro Kaewtathip made history by becoming the first Thai figure skater to win a medal at an ISU Grand Prix event.</p>

data.title: No rest for Kingdom's riders as bigger Asian Games test looms
data.description: <p>Thai sprinters raced out of their skins to spring a surprise at the Track Asia Cup 2026, lifting the Kingdom to fourth spot in the continental rankings -- but there was little time to savour the achievement, with the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya bearing down fast.</p>

data.title: Arsenal deliver statement fightback to end Chelsea's flying start
data.description: LONDON - Arsenal delivered an emphatic response to Chelsea's emergence as potential Premier League title contenders with a 2-1 win that ended their rivals' unbeaten start on Sunday.

data.title: 'Nothing has changed': FIFA confirms Infantino to run for re-election
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Gianni Infantino will stand in next March's FIFA presidential election, despite the backlash over his now-abandoned plan to bring private investment into the World Cup, football's global governing body announced Sunday.

data.title: With joy and grief, Palestinian football marks return
data.description: AL-RAM (PALESTINIAN TERRITORIES) - Palestinian sports commentator Khalil Jadallah has spent the past three years mourning the athletes killed in the Gaza war. As Palestinian football officially resumed this week, his return to the stadium proved bittersweet.

data.title: Zheng stuns Keys as US Open upsets dim American hopes
data.description: NEW YORK - Zheng Qinwen won the last seven games to stun Madison Keys and reach the US Open last 16 on a Saturday of upsets that dented American hopes at Flushing Meadows.

data.title: Newcomers Pattani hold giants Pathum as T1 season kicks off
data.description: Coach Vladimir Vujovic conceded that BG Pathum United created several openings but had to settle for a point after being held 0-0 by newly promoted Pattani FC in the opening match of the Thai League 1 season on Friday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stamp Fairtex eyes Chihiro Sawada for MMA return after Flores win
data.description: Stamp Fairtex is targeting an MMA return in early 2027 after beating Selina Flores at ONE Fight Night 47 – with Chihiro Sawada and Itsuki Hirata among the opponents she would welcome.

data.title: Thai queens off to Japan for a tilt at gold
data.description: <p>The Thai women's national volleyball team departed for Japan on Thursday night to begin their final preparation for the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya following their historic Olympic qualification.</p>

data.title: Three's a crowd at Championship summit
data.description: <p>Although it is very early days in the English season, there is already quite a scrap going on at the top of the Championship with an unlikely trio leading the way.</p>

data.title: Antonsen makes it three wins in a row over Kunlavut
data.description: <p>Kunlavut Vitidsarn bowed out in the quarter-finals of the US$1.25 million BWF China Masters in Shenzhen yesterday as all Thai players exited the Super 750 tournament at the last-eight stage.</p>

data.title: Siwa strike puts Kingdom on the cusp
data.description: <p>Thailand moved three points clear at the top of Group F in the AFC U20 Asian Cup China 2027 Qualifiers on Thursday night with a 1-0 win over Turkmenistan at Chonburi Stadium.</p>

data.title: Thai volleyballers aim for medal at Asian Games
data.description: The Thai women’s volleyball team have set their sights on at least a medal in the Asian Games, having already received a huge confidence boost from booking a ticket to the 2028 Olympics.

data.title: Night-owl Zverev goes distance to advance as upsets rock US Open
data.description: NEW YORK - Top-seeded Alexander Zverev kept his bid for a first US Open title on track with a gritty five-set victory over Quentin Halys, staying the course as a spate of upsets rocked the men's draw on Thursday.

data.title: Arsenal brace for Chelsea test as Spurs seek spark
data.description: LONDON — Something has to give when Arsenal host Chelsea in the Premier League this weekend, with both teams putting their 100 percent records on the line, while Tottenham are desperate to stop the rot.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stamp Fairtex vs Selina Flores official for Fight Night 47 main event
data.description: Stamp Fairtex and Selina Flores made their ONE Fight Night 47 main event official on Thursday evening after both passed hydration and made weight in Bangkok.

data.title: ONE Championship: Ferrari Fairtex vs Akif Guluzada main event scrapped after 3.6lb weight miss
data.description: Ferrari Fairtex’s scheduled ONE Championship kickboxing debut against Akif Guluzada has been scrapped from Friday night’s The Inner Circle 29 after the Azerbaijani missed the bantamweight limit by 3.6lb.

data.title: Kyrgios gets month ban for cocaine, enters treatment programme
data.description: SYDNEY — Australia's Nick Kyrgios was cleared Friday to return to tennis after accepting a one-month ban for using cocaine and entering a treatment programme.

data.title: Westerners test their mettle at World Nomad Games in Kyrgyzstan
data.description: CHOLPON-ATA — From wrestling horseback to battling for control of a headless goat, Central Asia's unique sports have been in the spotlight this week as Kyrgyzstan hosts the World Nomad Games, a biannual competition dedicated to nomadic traditions.

data.title: Premier League transfer windfall a lifeline for ailing French clubs
data.description: PARIS - Record spending by English Premier League clubs in the summer transfer window has served as a lifeline across the Channel in France, where cash-strapped teams are more reliant on selling their best players for big money than ever before.

data.title: Kunlavut marches into QF as Ratchanok crashes out
data.description: <p>Thai star Kunlavut Vitidsarn cruised into the quarter-finals of the BWF China Masters, but compatriot Ratchanok Intanon suffered a shock loss in Shenzhen on Thursday.</p>

data.title: Saysunee and Chitiphat lead home charge
data.description: <p>The Thai wheelchair fencing team claimed two gold, one silver and two bronze medals at the 2026 Para Fencing World Cup Pattaya at the National Eastern Sports Centre in Chon Buri.</p>

data.title: Buriram eye repeat, foes scramble
data.description: <p>In every competition there are contenders, and there are pretenders. Increasingly, though, Thai League 1 looks like one of the rare leagues anywhere that can also boast a permanent winner.</p>
